window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes were thin for US federal and Brazilian sources; only verifiable items are included.

stories.headline: Ecuador finds 1.6 tonnes of cocaine inside an industrial metal separator at Guayaquil, bound for Mexico
stories.summary: Police at the Port of Guayaquil opened an export container and found 1,684 blocks of cocaine, about 1,676 kg net, concealed in a machine declared as a metal separator.

stories.headline: Colombian police pull 295 kilos of cocaine from a cocoa-cake container at Cartagena, headed from Peru to Spain
stories.summary: Officers at the port of Cartagena found the cocaine hidden in a shipment of cocoa cake that originated in Peru and was destined for Spain. The report mentions no arrests.

stories.headline: Colombia's government reports 611 kilos of cocaine in Ibagué and a tonne of marijuana in Mitú in a single day
stories.summary: In a 24-hour tally announced by President Abelardo de la Espriella, police stopped a truck carrying 611.8 kg of cocaine in Ibagué, Tolima, and arrested its driver.

stories.headline: Spain and Ecuador arrest 21, including two serving officers, in Operation Machala cocaine network takedown
stories.summary: About 130 officers carried out 23 simultaneous searches in both countries, seizing 630 kg of cocaine and a second stash of roughly 1.5 tonnes in this phase.
